name: Water chillers
tagline: Central plant cooling for large buildings and processes
description: High-capacity cooling systems that chill water for process cooling, central HVAC, and large building loads.
long_description: Chillers cool water that is pumped to AHUs, fan coil units or process equipment across a building or plant. Air-cooled chillers reject heat through fans, and water-cooled chillers use a cooling tower for higher efficiency at scale. They suit sites where many zones or machines need steady, controllable cooling around the clock.
features: Feeds AHUs, FCUs and industrial process equipment
Staged or variable capacity for part-load efficiency
Built for continuous duty in critical facilities

specs.label: Leaving water temp.
specs.value: Typically 6 – 7 °C for comfort; lower for process duty

variants.suits: Large campuses and central plants (screw / centrifugal)

considerations: Water-cooled chillers are more efficient but need a cooling tower and water treatment
N+1 redundancy is recommended for critical facilities
Plan plant-room or rooftop space, pumps and piping early

faqs.question: Air-cooled or water-cooled?
faqs.answer: Air-cooled is simpler with no cooling tower or water use. Water-cooled is more efficient for large, continuous loads where water is reliably available.

faqs.question: Do you service existing chillers?
faqs.answer: Yes. We handle breakdowns, annual maintenance, tube cleaning, refrigerant work and controls on most major brands.
